login_username.description: Instagram username for logging in to download private profiles. If empty, login is skipped.

download_stories.description: Instruct Instaloader to download the user's stories.

download_highlights.description: Download the highlights of the profile.

download_tagged.description: Download posts where the user is tagged.

fast_update.description: Stop downloading when the first already-downloaded picture is encountered.

download_latest_stamps.description: Store and use timestamps to only download newer media.

download_geotags.description: Download geotags of each post and save them as Google Maps links.

no_captions.description: Do not create .txt files with post captions.

no_videos.description: Skip downloading videos (specifically for sidecar posts).

dirname_pattern.description: Configure the directory name of each target. Supports tokens like {target} and {profile}.

filename_pattern.description: Configure the path of the post files relative to the target directory. Supports tokens like {shortcode}, {date_utc}, {profile}.

title_pattern.description: Configure the name for profile pics, hashtag profile pics, and highlight covers. If empty, uses default logic.

post_filter.description: Python boolean expression to filter posts (e.g., 'likes > 100' or 'not is_video').

storyitem_filter.description: Python boolean expression to filter story items (e.g., 'expiring_utc > datetime.now()').

post_metadata_txt.description: Template for the content of the .txt file alongside each post. Supports post attributes.

storyitem_metadata_txt.description: Template for the content of the .txt file alongside each story item. If empty, no metadata file is created.
